마법봉 또는 지팡이에 있는 빈 증강물 홈에 장착하여 그 아이템에 효과를: Place into an empty Augment Socket in a Wand or Staff to apply its effect to that item. Once socketed it cannot be retrieved but can be replaced by other Augment items.
무기 또는 장화에 있는 빈 증강물 홈에 장착하여 그 아이템에 효과를 적용: Place into an empty Augment Socket in a weapon or pair of Boots to apply its effect to that item. Once socketed it cannot be retrieved but can be replaced by other Augment items.
방패, 버클러 또는 셉터에 있는 빈 증강물 홈에 장착하여 그 아이템에 효: Place into an empty Augment Socket in a Shield, Buckler or a Sceptre to apply its effect to that item. Once socketed it cannot be retrieved but can be replaced by other Augment items.
